title: Studio Bagno's Cutting Edge Design & Technology Selected For Brisbane's Spectacular New Howard Smith Wharf Development
bodyHtml:
Studio Bagno products have been selected by Andrew Parr of SJB Interiors Melbourne for the new five star boutique hotel at Brisbane’s Howard Smith Wharf developed by the Deague Group and with Hutchinson Builders.

Oli 74 in-wall cisterns have been chosen thanks to their advanced technology - they are the only cisterns in the Australian market with delayed refill technology resulting in massive water and dollar savings for the hotel.

Oli cisterns are alone in that the inlet valve will not open until the discharge valve has closed, hence the substantial water savings.

The cisterns have been teamed with Slim actuator plates in soft touch matte black which perfectly match the stunning matte black glazed Nicole wall faced pans.

This dramatic combination of high end style with well-considered technical advantages perfectly complements a truly outstanding development.

The hotel will be nestled beneath the Story Bridge and will feature innovative architectural detailing , an onsite brewery, several restaurants and unrivalled views of the Brisbane River.

The Howard Smith Wharf Project is due for completion in early 2019. You can check out our Nicole WFP, Oli In-Wall Cisterns and Flush Buttons in our extensive online catalogue
